==Usage==
This template is used to cite content from the [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] published by [[De Agostini]]. The (reference book) parenthetical is added automatically, and thus is not necessary.

==Instructions==
<pre><nowiki>{{EncyclopediaCite|BOOKLET TITLE}}</nowiki></pre>

===Example(s)===
<code><nowiki>{{EncyclopediaCite|Millennium Falcon}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{EncyclopediaCite|Millennium Falcon}}

==Icon==
[[File:AltayaCite.svg|thumb|left|x16px]]

Note that this icon was removed from the template due to Wookieepedia's MediaWiki software limitations on template size.
